mechanism: Both drugs increase CNS depression and neuropsychiatric effects; amitriptyline is metabolized by CYP1A2 which varenicline may weakly inhibit, and combined use may potentiate anticholinergic and sedative effects.
action: Monitor for increased sedation, dizziness, and neuropsychiatric symptoms; consider dose adjustment of amitriptyline if CNS effects are excessive; counsel on avoiding alcohol and other CNS depressants.
